findings.evidence: Unlike the built-in general-purpose agent, it returns Result, Changes, Validation and Remaining blockers.
findings.fix: Coordinate multi-file, multi-component programming work end to end: break the request down, delegate to matching specialists or implement directly, integrate their changes and run the project's verification gates. Use for complex multi-step debugging, implementation or refactoring that spans several files or components, or when specialist results need integrating and verifying, even if coordination is not requested. Not for trivial one-step edits or a focused single-domain task a dedicated specialist owns.
